The '''2026 United States Senate election in Alabama''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Alabama]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Congressman [[Barry Moore (American politician)|Barry Moore]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] attorney Everett Wess are the nominees for their respective parties. Republican incumbent [[Tommy Tuberville]] is not seeking a second term in order to [[2026 Alabama gubernatorial election|run for governor]].<ref name="Tuberville" />

[[Primary election]]s were held on May 19, which were followed by [[Two round system|runoffs]] for both parties on June 16 after no candidates received a majority.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Cason |first1=Mike |title=The date of Alabama's landmark 2026 primary elections has changed: Here's why |url=https://www.al.com/politics/2025/05/the-date-of-alabamas-landmark-2026-primary-elections-has-changed-heres-why.html |website=AL.com |date=May 12, 2025 |access-date=1 August 2025}}</ref> Moore won the Republican runoff with 55.8% of the vote over businessman Jared Hudson and Wess won the Democratic runoff with 54.6% of the vote over businessman Dakarai Larriett.
